Rina: Need a crisp proposal for model lifecycle SLAs: onboarding gates, pin TTLs, and deprecation economics. Customers keep asking for predictable timelines + credits. Quick brainstorm?
Diego: +1. Can we standardize onboarding gates first? My take: bench pass (95+), hw_fit verified, telemetry hook integrated, and at least 48h shadow run or 100k synthetic tokens.
Nora: 48h shadow is heavy. Suggest flexible shadow: small tenants get 48h synthetic + 10k tokens; enterprise gets 48h shadow or opt-in pilot. Make it a matrix.
Cal: For pin TTLs: default pin = 180 days, auto-notify at 60/30/10 days. If customer requests extension, CS creates a ticket and legal signs off for >180 days. Also allow emergency 7-day extension via on-call.
Rina: Deprecation bands proposal: immediate (critical bug/security), short (7d notice), standard (30d), extended (90d). Assign band by impact_score and contractual pins.
Diego: How to compute impact_score? I propose: sum over customers (usage_share * tier_weight) + embed_schema_change_flag*50 + pin_count*100. Normalize to 0-100.
Nora: Don't forget lineage risk. Families with >10% migration failures get a +20 penalty to impact_score and require canary cohort.
Cal: Migration credits: baseline 20% of monthly bill if migrated within window; enterprise negotiate larger credits. Track credit issuance automatically and attach audit record.
cs-bot: Note: last deprecation (1829004321) used ad-hoc 15% credit; manual CS outreach logged.
Rina: On rollback/quick-exit: define signals and thresholds. Example: bench regression >5% absolute, latency p95 increase >30% or >250ms, hallucination metric +10pp. Any triggered -> pause rollout and trigger rollback workflow.
Diego: Agree. Also require a human-in-the-loop for customer-facing rollbacks. Auto-rollback okay for internal canaries.
Nora: For onboarding telemetry, require these hooks: p95 latency, error-rate, throughput, top-10 output diffs for eval set. Console should surface suspect changes with confidence scores.
Cal: Implementation: 1) Policy DSL for bands and score calc, 2) Console UI for pin lifecycle and renewal prompts, 3) Billing automation for credits, 4) Runbooks for shadow/rollback. Estimate MVP = 3 sprints.
Rina: Owners: Rina=policy doc + comm templates, Diego=score engine + PoC, Nora=bench spec + telemetry, Cal=billing runbook + pin ops. Action items: Diego PoC by Fri, Nora bench spec Wed, Cal billing prototype next Tue.
Diego: I'll include example scoring pseudo: `impact = sum(usage_share * tier) + 50*schema_change + 100*pin_count; band = if impact>80 then extended else if impact>40 then standard else short`
Nora: Also need a public "catalog calendar" page listing upcoming onboards and sunsets monthly. Helps customers plan.
Cal: Agree. Comms cadence: initial notice -> 30d -> 7d -> 48h -> 24h for short/standard bands. Fast band should include immediate CS outreach.
Rina: Any objections to converting this to an RFC? We'll include sample customer templates and credit calculator.
Diego: No objections. +1 to RFC.
Nora: +1. Will draft bench sample spec and recommend a 95% pass threshold with per-metric guards.
Cal: +1. I'll draft billing flow and audit events.
